headlines.title: Exelon shares rise 2% on third quarter earnings beat
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- On Friday, Exelon Corporation (NASDAQ:EXC) reported third quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, with adjusted earnings per share of $0.87 compared to the consensus estimate of $0.80.

headlines.title: Exelon: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
headlines.summary: CHICAGO (AP) — CHICAGO (AP) — Exelon Corp. (EXC) on Friday reported third-quarter earnings of $729 million.

headlines.title: Exelon (EXC) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Reassess Rates And Growth
headlines.summary: Exelon’s valuation work now reflects a small shift, with the internal fair value estimate moving from US$48.71 to US$47.59 as analysts revisit their models. This adjustment lines up with recent research that presents a mixed setup, where higher rates, data center related demand expectations, and regulatory factors are all feeding into more cautious price targets in the mid to high US$40s.

headlines.title: Exelon to Post Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
headlines.summary: EXC's Q3 earnings may have benefited from rate hikes, rising power demand and grid upgrades, while storm-related repair costs could have weighed on profitability.

headlines.title: The Hidden Catalyst That Could Send Exelon Stock Back to $50 on Oct. 30
headlines.summary: Exelon reports earnings before the open on Oct. 30, and buried inside the call is a transmission pipeline question that could shift how Wall Street prices this utility for years to come.

description: Exelon Corporation, a utility services holding company, engages in the energy distribution and transmission businesses in the United States. The company is involved in the purchase and regulated retail sale of electricity and natural gas; transmission and distribution of electricity; and distribution of natural gas to retail customers. It serves residential, commercial, industrial, and public authorities and electric railroads customers. Exelon Corporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
